slides.teacher_cue: New sound. Tongue tip touches the ridge just behind the upper teeth — same place as /n/ and /d/ — but air flows around both sides. Voice on. Mirror work mandatory: both /l/ and /r/ must be drilled and contrasted from this lesson onwards.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /l/ cleanly with tongue tip contact at the alveolar ridge.
slides.correction_move: Mirror work: /l/ — tongue tip touches ridge, contact visible. /r/ — tongue curls back, no contact. Students alternate slowly before any word practice.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /r/ and /l/ confusion — both phonemes are now taught. From this lesson, minimal pair drilling is mandatory in every Block 01 review.

slides.teacher_cue: Say the new focus, then connect l to one strong word from today.
